channel.title: East Lansing, MI - News Flash - News Releases
channel.description: East Lansing, MI - Get the latest news

item.title: East Lansing Fire Department Offers Safety Tips for Thanksgiving Cooking
item.description: The East Lansing Fire Department (ELFD), along with the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), has offered tips for community members to stay safe in the kitchen this holiday season.

item.title: 11-Week ELPD Citizens’ Police Academy Begins Wednesday, Feb. 3
item.description: Community members are invited to apply for the East Lansing Police Department’s (ELPD) 11-week Citizens’ Police Academy, which begins Wednesday, Feb. 3, 2027.

item.title: New Compactors Installed at East Lansing Recycling Drop-Off, Thanks to State Grant
item.description: New recycling compactors have been installed at the East Lansing Department of Public Works (DPW), thanks to a grant from the Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes and Energy (EGLE).

item.title: East Lansing Police Department Issues Statement on Weekend Assault Incident
item.description: In the early morning hours of Sunday, Sept. 13, an officer with the East Lansing Police Department (ELPD) was on foot patrol in Downtown East Lansing when he was assaulted with bear spray by a passenger in a passing vehicle.

item.title: 54-B District Court Administrator Earns National Recognition from Institute for Court Management
item.description: Nicole Evans, the court administrator for 54-B District Court in East Lansing, has been certified as a fellow of the Institute for Court Management (ICM) at the National Center for State Courts.

item.title: Prime Time Senior Programs Offers Continuous Learning Collaborative
item.description: The East Lansing Prime Time Senior Programs has launched a Continuous Learning Collaborative, a new initiative to provide continuous education opportunities for older adults.

item.title: Parks and Recreation Advisory Commission Seeks Applicants
item.description: The East Lansing Parks and Recreation Advisory Commission is seeking applicants to fill a vacancy.

item.title: A Portion of the Bailey Street Parking Lot to Close Friday, Oct. 2
item.description: Community members are advised that a large portion of the Bailey Street Parking Lot, 139 Bailey St., will close as of Friday, Oct. 2.

item.title: East Lansing Public Library Unveils New Empathy and Equity Box
item.description: The East Lansing Public Library, 950 Abbot Road, has unveiled a new Empathy and Equity Box. The anonymously accessible pantry provides emergency resources and information sheets about how to access additional resources in the Greater Lansing area.

item.title: East Lansing City Council Appoints Annette Irwin as Interim City Manager
item.description: The East Lansing City Council announced today that it appointed Annette Irwin as Interim City Manager effective June 22, 2026. Irwin will serve until a permanent replacement is named for former City Manager Robert Belleman, who has voluntarily resigned.

item.title: Two East Lansing Employees Chosen for Bloomberg’s Path to Public Innovation
item.description: Two City of East Lansing employees have recently been accepted into the Bloomberg Center for Public Innovation’s Path to Public Innovation training program.

item.title: Statement from East Lansing Police Chief Brown Regarding the Incident Outside Harper’s on Aug. 2
City of East Lansing Issues Statement on the 2025 Use of Force Report
item.description: East Lansing Interim City Manager Annette Irwin has issued a statement regarding the 2025 Use of Force Report.

item.title: Redacted Video from August Incident at Harper’s Released Today
item.description: The East Lansing Police Department (ELPD) has released the video footage from an incident involving Myana Collins and several ELPD officers during the late night/early morning hours of Saturday, Aug. 1 and Sunday, Aug. 2, 2026.

item.title: City of East Lansing Will Not Pursue Charges in Aug. 2 Harper’s Incident
item.description: The East Lansing City Attorney’s Office will not pursue charges against Myanna Collins regarding the incident outside Harper’s Restaurant and Brewpub on Aug. 2.

item.title: DMB to Host Downtown East Lansing Tree Lighting Saturday, Nov. 21
item.description: Community members are invited to attend the Downtown East Lansing Tree Lighting on Saturday, Nov. 21. The event will be held from 5-7 p.m. at the Ann Street Plaza with the official lighting of the tree at 6 p.m.

item.title: ELPD Investigating Overnight Shootings, Makes Arrests in Two Serious Crashes
item.description: The East Lansing Police Department (ELPD) is actively investigating two separate shootings and has made arrests in two crashes involving pedestrians that took place in the overnight hours between Saturday, Oct. 31 and Sunday, Nov. 1.

item.title: East Lansing Youth Theater Program Presents ‘Annie KIDS’ Nov. 20-21
item.description: The City of East Lansing’s Youth Theater Program will present “Annie KIDS” for its fall production.

item.title: City Office and Facility Closures in Observance of Thanksgiving Holiday
item.description: City of East Lansing offices and facilities will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, in observance of Thanksgiving.

item.title: MLK Commission to Participate in ‘Walk to School With Ruby Day’
item.description: The Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Commission of Mid-Michigan will join the Red Cedar Elementary School parents, students and community on Wednesday, Nov. 18, for Walk to School With Ruby Day.

item.title: City Responds to Nuisance Fires Set After MSU Win Over U-M
item.description: The East Lansing Fire Department (ELFD) responded to more than 50 nuisance fires set in the City between Saturday, Nov. 7, and Sunday, Nov. 8, in the hours after Michigan State University’s football team defeated the University of Michigan.

item.title: Community Invited to Wreath Laying Ceremony Tuesday, Nov. 10
item.description: Community members are invited to attend a wreath laying ceremony on Tuesday, Nov. 10, in honor of Veterans Day.

item.title: City Offices to Close Wednesday, Nov. 11, in Observance of Veterans Day
item.description: City of East Lansing offices and facilities will be closed Wednesday, Nov. 11, in observance of Veterans Day.

item.title: Voting Precincts Update; New Voter Identification Cards to be Mailed
item.description: All registered voters in the City of East Lansing are advised they will receive new voter identification cards. The new ID cards will arrive in the mail in the coming weeks and replace any existing voter ID cards.

item.title: Intersection of Albert Avenue, Milford Street to Close for CWSRF Project
item.description: Community members are advised the intersection of Albert Avenue and Milford Street will temporarily close beginning Monday, Nov. 16.

item.title: Hannah Community Center Elevator to Close for Modernization Project
item.description: The elevator at the East Lansing Hannah Community Center (ELHCC), 819 Abbot Road, will close for a modernization project beginning Monday, Oct. 12. The closure is expected to last approximately three weeks.

item.title: City and MSU Collaborate to Install New Art in Downtown East Lansing
item.description: New art has been installed in Downtown East Lansing in collaboration with Michigan State University.

item.title: ELPD Investigation into Weekend Shootings Continues, Requests Info from Community
item.description: The East Lansing Police Department (ELPD) continues to investigate two shootings that took place over the weekend. There appears to be no threat to the general public and no connection between these two incidents.

item.title: East Lansing City Hall to Serve as Election Day Vote Center on Nov. 3
item.description: East Lansing City Hall, 410 Abbot Road, will serve as an Election Day Vote Center on Tuesday, Nov. 3, for same-day voter registration.

item.title: City to Host Early Voting Site at WKAR on Michigan State University’s Campus
item.description: he East Lansing City Clerk has partnered with Michigan State University (MSU) and WKAR Public Media to host an Early Voting Site on MSU’s campus at WKAR Studio A for the Nov. 3, 2026 Election.

item.title: East Lansing, Michigan State Partnering to Host Data Week Events
item.description: The City of East Lansing and Michigan State University are partnering to offer informational events during the week of Oct. 19.

item.title: East Lansing’s Annual Flushing of Water Mains to Begin Monday, Sept. 21
Applications Open for FY2028 Community Development Block Grant
item.description: The City of East Lansing is now accepting applications for Fiscal Year (FY) 2028 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program funding. The deadline to apply is 5 p.m. Monday, Dec. 14.

item.title: Portion of Albert Avenue to Close for Light Installation Week of Oct. 26-30
item.description: Community members are advised a portion of Albert Avenue will close for lighting installation along the Albert Avenue pedestrian skywalk the week of Oct. 26-30.

item.title: City of East Lansing Shares Tips for How to Safely Have Fun This Halloween
item.description: The City of East Lansing wants everybody to have a safe, memorable and fun Halloween this year. Halloween is celebrated on Saturday, Oct. 31.

item.title: Commission on the Environment Seeks Applicants to Fill Vacancy
item.description: The East Lansing City Council is accepting applications to fill a vacancy on the Commission on the Environment.

item.title: Great Pumpkin Walk Set for Sunday, Oct. 25, in Downtown East Lansing
item.description: The Great Pumpkin Walk will be held from 1-4 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 25, in Downtown East Lansing. As part of the annual Great Pumpkin Walk, a 26-foot-tall inflatable pumpkin will take over Ann Street Plaza on the corner of M.A.C. and Albert avenues.
